entries.name: alert.channel_failed
entries.summary: A notification channel delivery failed; the channel row records the error tail (diagnostics face).

entries.name: alert.fired
entries.summary: A threshold alert rule transitioned to firing (breach held for the rule's for-window); notification channels were attempted.

entries.name: alert.resolved
entries.summary: A firing threshold alert rule transitioned back to ok (observed value fell below the threshold).

entries.name: app
entries.summary: AppSpec: desired state of a long-running deployable unit (an app is one or more processes).

entries.name: app.created
entries.summary: An app was created.

entries.name: app.deleted
entries.summary: An app was deleted (teardown per ADR-0023).

entries.name: app.teardown_aborted
entries.summary: An app delete was aborted after teardown because a deployment was admitted mid-delete; the in-flight deployment rebuilds the carriers (ADR-0023).

entries.name: build.building
entries.summary: Build started executing.

entries.name: build.cancelled
entries.summary: Build cancelled.

entries.name: build.expired
entries.summary: Build expired by timeout watchdog.

entries.name: build.failed
entries.summary: Build failed.

entries.name: build.queued
entries.summary: Build accepted into build queue.

entries.name: build.succeeded
entries.summary: Build produced an image digest.

entries.name: config.updated
entries.summary: A config version was written.

entries.name: database
entries.summary: DatabaseSpec: desired state of a managed data service (template-rendered, rides the Runtime channel).

entries.name: database.backup_failed
entries.summary: A database backup failed; the payload carries the error tail (utility container stderr included).

entries.name: database.backup_succeeded
entries.summary: A database backup completed; the payload carries the object key, sha256 digest and size (the restore-verification anchors).

entries.name: database.created
entries.summary: A database was created from a template; the platform minted its credential secret (value never returned).

entries.name: database.deleted
entries.summary: A database was deleted (carriers torn down, row tombstoned; volume and credential secret retained as project materials).

entries.name: database.restored
entries.summary: A database restore completed (stream into a running target or volume pre-seeding before first start).

entries.name: deployment.building
entries.summary: Deployment entered build stage.

entries.name: deployment.cancelled
entries.summary: Deployment cancelled while queued or in flight.

entries.name: deployment.failed
entries.summary: Deployment reached failed terminal state.

entries.name: deployment.first_boot_job
entries.summary: A deploy-time first boot job was minted as a one-shot task; the deployment waits in releasing for its terminal state before materializing carriers (ADR-0030).

entries.name: deployment.observing
entries.summary: Deployment entered health observation window.

entries.name: deployment.preparing
entries.summary: Deployment started preparing spec and materials.

entries.name: deployment.queued
entries.summary: Deployment accepted by admission queue.

entries.name: deployment.releasing
entries.summary: Deployment started releasing workloads to runtime.

entries.name: deployment.rolling_back
entries.summary: Deployment started replaying last successful revision.

entries.name: deployment.succeeded
entries.summary: Deployment reached succeeded terminal state.

entries.name: deployment.superseded
entries.summary: Deployment superseded by a newer one.

entries.name: exec.session_opened
entries.summary: An exec session was accepted into a running workload (actor, process, instance, node and command are in the payload; change freeze is exempt — diagnostics face).

entries.name: freeze.lifted
entries.summary: A change freeze was lifted; change verbs in scope are accepted again.

entries.name: freeze.set
entries.summary: A change freeze was set for a team (or globally); change verbs in scope are refused with the reason.

entries.name: hook.push_accepted
entries.summary: A verified webhook push triggered a deployment.

entries.name: invitation.accepted
entries.summary: An invitation was redeemed; the invitee became a user.

entries.name: invitation.created
entries.summary: An invitation was issued (single-use, time-boxed, role-bound).

entries.name: lease.expired
entries.summary: A task's owner lease expired past grace; the pool drains.

entries.name: lease.renewed
entries.summary: A task's owner lease was renewed (deadline advanced).

entries.name: network.created
entries.summary: A project network was created.

entries.name: network.peer_approved
entries.summary: The receiving project approved a peer attachment; references become projectable.

entries.name: network.peer_declared
entries.summary: A peer project declared intent to attach to a network (pending; needs receiver approval).

entries.name: network.peer_revoked
entries.summary: A peer attachment was revoked; existing attachments are isolated by an immediate isolate reconverge (ADR-0013 appendix A.4).

entries.name: network.rebuilt
entries.summary: A project network carrier was rebuilt through the platform in the attachable form; attached carriers were detached and re-attached.

entries.name: node.joined
entries.summary: Node joined the cluster and was anchored with a platform node ID.

entries.name: node.left
entries.summary: Node left the cluster.

entries.name: platform.backup_failed
entries.summary: A platform backup failed; the payload carries the restic error tail.

entries.name: platform.backup_succeeded
entries.summary: A platform backup (restic snapshot of the control-plane data root) completed on all configured repos.

entries.name: project.created
entries.summary: A project was created.

entries.name: project.deleted
entries.summary: A project was deleted (tombstoned).

entries.name: role.created
entries.summary: A custom role was created from a scope set.

entries.name: run.created
entries.summary: A run was created and queued for carrier ensure.

entries.name: run.failed
entries.summary: A run reached the failed terminal state.

entries.name: run.running
entries.summary: A run's workload was observed running.

entries.name: run.stopped
entries.summary: A run reached the stopped terminal state.

entries.name: run.stopping
entries.summary: A run started stopping (stop reason carried on the row).

entries.name: schedule.created
entries.summary: A schedule was created (timezone-aware cron, first fire time computed).

entries.name: schedule.deleted
entries.summary: A schedule was deleted (tombstoned; already-spawned tasks run to completion).

entries.name: schedule.fired
entries.summary: A schedule fired and spawned a one-shot task (source: cron or manual).

entries.name: schedule.skipped
entries.summary: A due schedule fire was skipped (reason: overlap while the previous run is in flight, or quota_exceeded when the project is at its task quota).

entries.name: secret.deleted
entries.summary: A secret was deleted.

entries.name: secret.updated
entries.summary: A secret value was set (fingerprint, never the value).

entries.name: task
entries.summary: TaskSpec: desired state of a programmatic workload (one-shot or resident, ADR-0012).

entries.name: task.active
entries.summary: A drained task was revived by an owner lease renewal.

entries.name: task.completed
entries.summary: A one-shot task's run completed successfully.

entries.name: task.created
entries.summary: A task was created (one-shot or resident form).

entries.name: task.deleted
entries.summary: A task was deleted (carriers removed, row tombstoned).

entries.name: task.drained
entries.summary: A draining task reached drained state (all runs terminal).

entries.name: task.draining
entries.summary: A task started draining: replenishment stopped; in-flight runs stop with grace or run out their TTL.

entries.name: task.failed
entries.summary: A one-shot task's run failed.

entries.name: task.updated
entries.summary: A task's desired concurrency was updated.

entries.name: team.created
entries.summary: A team was created.

entries.name: template.instantiated
entries.summary: A template was instantiated into a deployment (payload carries the template name@version and the deployment id).

entries.name: templates.refreshed
entries.summary: The template catalog snapshot was refreshed (payload carries the previous and new aggregate digests and the entry count).

entries.name: token.created
entries.summary: A token was minted (secret shown once at creation).

entries.name: token.revoked
entries.summary: A token was revoked; its next call will be rejected.

entries.name: upload.stored
entries.summary: An uploaded source was stored (content-addressed; payload carries id, digest, size and deduplicated).

entries.name: user.created
entries.summary: A user was created and granted a role in a team.

entries.name: variable.deleted
entries.summary: A project shared variable was deleted.

entries.name: variable.updated
entries.summary: A project shared variable was set (values are readable via the API; redeploy affected apps to pick up the new value).

entries.name: volume.created
entries.summary: A volume was created.

entries.name: workload.drift_detected
entries.summary: Observed workload diverged from the ensured generation or spec (ADR-0022).

entries.name: workload.stopped
entries.summary: A steady-state workload was observed stopped at the current generation.
